# かもしれない・だろう・でしょう・はず — the certainty ladder

**[かもしれない](<../grammar/kamo-shirenai.md> "Might or may; expresses a possibility the speaker considers uncertain")**
:   The 'maybe' rung — possible, no commitment: 雨が降るかもしれない。Lower confidence than だろう/でしょう; the speaker won't be surprised either way.

**[だろう](<../grammar/darou.md> "Probably or presumably; plain-form prediction with relatively strong confidence")**
:   Plain-form 'probably' — a confident guess: 明日は晴れるだろう。The casual/written counterpart of でしょう; can sound blunt in conversation.

**[でしょう (prediction)](<../grammar/deshou.md#prediction> "Probably will; polite prediction based on expectation or reasoning")**
:   Polite 'probably' — a prediction offered to an audience: 午後は雨になるでしょう。The weather-forecast form; だろう's confidence, one register up.

**[はず](<../grammar/hazu.md> "Should be or is expected to be; confident expectation from evidence")**
:   Reasoned expectation — something concrete makes it so: 送ったから、届くはずだ。Grounds-based, unlike でしょう's guess; if it fails, you're surprised.
